source: Owner-supplied Alfred v0.3 handoff; reconciled by the approved 10 November 2026 design brief. Report v5 was not supplied and was not inspected.

colorNotes.ink2: Lightened from the spec's initial #4F4B44 for clearer hierarchy against ink; verified contrast ratio stays >=4.5:1 on paper and sand (see contrast.json).
colorNotes.line: Ink at 18% alpha, for the rare thin helper rule. Most dividers use a solid 1.5px ink line instead.
colorNotes.removed: Pure white (#FFFFFF), pure black, and v0.2's pink (#FF4FA0) and blue (#1975FF) are not part of this palette.

accentGuidance: Yellow is dosed, used only where it means something: the primary CTA, one warning/callout card per screen, small markers (the star, the arrow-button dot, the lead tag pill), and the circle decoration beside a hero heading. Never section headings, ribbons, whole-section backgrounds, lot numbers, or resting link underlines.

display.role: Headings only (h1/h2/h3). Never numbers, prices, the logo, buttons or captions.
display.status: Instrument Serif 400 is the approved display face for Latin/Latin-ext. Cyrillic headings use bundled Cormorant Garamond 400 under the same CSS family alias; this companion is not Instrument Serif glyphs.

files.note: Real Cormorant Garamond 400 glyphs, declared under the Instrument Serif family name so Cyrillic headings keep a serif that reads the same brand register, instead of dropping to the Georgia fallback.

body.role: Everything else: body copy, labels, buttons, logo-adjacent UI, big numbers, prices.

files.note: Original handoff filename incorrectly said Cyrillic. Bytes preserved; corrected to Latin-ext.

body.status: Bundled Outfit supports Latin and Latin-ext. Cyrillic body copy uses system-ui fallback and will vary by device. No bundled Cyrillic Outfit is claimed.

shape.note: One outline everywhere: 1.5px solid ink. No hard offset shadows, no double borders.

layout.railNote: Section rail (h2) vs content splits by flex-basis (220px vs 560px) and wraps on its own; there is no separate fixed breakpoint for it.

star.note: The four-point star marker. Fill accent, stroke ink 1.5px.

typographyNotes: Every size floors at 14px; nothing is set in solid caps or a monospace face. h1 should resolve to 1-2 lines on desktop (text-wrap: balance).

spacing.note: Values follow the spec's named relationships, not a strict 4px ladder (card-group-gap is 14px by design). When in doubt, use more space, not less.
